acceptance_predicates.description: Wizard selections are drawn from the current connected provider/model catalog and unavailable combinations are typed.
One selected provider/auth/model setting can be applied as the default for all selected agents, with explicit overrides retained.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management are warnings and never block local/mock setup.
Reviewed provider/model/auth and agent-default selections survive restart without secrets.
Human and JSON readiness output contains redacted metadata only.

definition_of_done: Fresh-user selection journey and restart tests pass.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass.
